ops.title: capt-hook: hook runner infra failure fails closed — decide fail-open vs fail-closed
ops.description: Observed in session fe81f529-8950-4faa-bfe3-b6f8335515c3 (project getaway) at 2026-07-15 03:32:05 UTC: the PreToolUse:Workflow hook runner itself failed — 'uvx --isolated capt-hook run PreToolUse' hit a pypi fetch timeout for fsspec after 3 retries (46.6s) — and the infra failure BLOCKED the Workflow tool call outright (recorded denial_kind: permission-rule) instead of failing open. An advisory-nudge dispatch that cannot even resolve its own dependencies denied a legitimate tool call. Whether hook-infra errors should fail open (skip the hook, allow the call) or fail closed (current behavior) is an owner/design decision — gates arguably fail closed, pure nudges arguably fail open. Adjacent to task f976c24 (daemon/client dispatch semantics).

ops.text: Decision recorded: fail-open vs fail-closed per hook kind (gate vs nudge) on runner infra errors
Either implemented in the dispatch path or the current fail-closed behavior documented as intended
